title: Improvements to mechanical response tissue analysis
author: Bowman, Loucks

steps.title: Integrate accelerance FRF
steps.instruction: Integrate the complex accelerance frequency response function (FRF) a/F twice with respect to frequency to obtain the complex compliance FRF x/F.

steps.title: Invert compliance FRF
steps.instruction: Invert the complex compliance FRF (x/F) to obtain the complex stiffness FRF (F/x).

steps.title: Fit polynomial to stiffness FRF
steps.instruction: Fit the fourth‑order rational polynomial given in Eq. (1) to the complex stiffness FRF (F/x) to determine the polynomial coefficients A0, A1, A2, A3, C0, and C1.

steps.title: Solve for model parameters
steps.instruction: Insert the obtained polynomial coefficients into the simultaneous equations listed in Eq. (3) and solve for the seven mechanical‑model parameters (KS, KB, MS, MB, DS, DB, DP).

steps.title: Alternative three‑step extraction
steps.instruction: Skip the inversion step: directly fit the inverse of Eq. (1) to the complex compliance FRF (x/F) to obtain the polynomial coefficients, then solve the simultaneous equations in Eq. (3) for the model parameters.
